query_analysis.original_query: Our PSA system is showing inefficient cycling due to delays in valve actuation. What control upgrades would you recommend to optimize adsorption/desorption timing?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate control system improvements to address valve actuation delays and optimize cycle timing in a pressure swing adsorption process.

selected_agents.role: Control system analysis and upgrade recommendations

communication_strategy.information_flow: Control system performance evaluation and enhancement proposals

clarification_questions: What are the current valve actuation delay times?
How are the adsorption and desorption steps currently timed and controlled?
Are there any constraints on control system modifications?
